Exam Date & Time: 10-May-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VI Semester - End Semester Examination - April / May -2024  
  Introduction to Internet of Things [NPT-3202]  
Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
1)               Evaluate the potential challenges and benefits of integrating Machine-to-Machine  
  (M2M) communications into the broader framework of the Internet of Things (IoT),  
  (4)  
  considering factors such as scalability, security, and network infrastructure.  
  A)  
  B)          Compare and contrast the IPv4 and IPv6 protocols in terms of their features,  
  addressing schemes, and suitability for accommodating the growing number of IoT          (3)  
  devices.  
  
  C)          Illustate the sensors which exhibit non-linearity in their response to varying inputs,  
  and what are the implications for accurate measurement and calibration?                  (3)  
  
2)               Discuss the protocol stack operation in Bluetooth with suitable diagram.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)          Outline the optimal steps involved in Optimal Geographical Density Control  
  (OGDC) Algorithm.                                                                        (5)  
  
3)               Illustrate by outlining a scenario where Python networking would be beneficial.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)          Analyse the basic architecture of Raspberry Pi with a suitable diagram.                  (3)  
  C)          Discuss the syntax used for creating a socket in programming                             (3)  
4)               Evaluate the layered approach commonly used in IoT architecture with suitable  
  diagram.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)          Illsutrate the Essential Characteristics of cloud computing.                             (5)  
5)               Illustrate the dictionary and List operations in Python with suitable examples.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)          Design a comprehensive plan for implementing a client-server communication  
  system using network protocols while sending data to a server.                           (5)  
  
  
-----End-----
